problems.text: Users are missing meeting updates because the notification bell blends into the UI
Only 12% of users have notifications enabled, which the Engineer Lead summarises as both a discovery and an adoption problem
The analytics warehouse is slow on aggregation queries because the schema is not partitioned by date and has too many indexed columns
Dark mode may be wanted by customers, but the Designer has not counted the requests

proposed_solutions.text: Redesign the notification UI: move the bell more central and add a color indicator for unread count
Add a badge counter to the notification UI
Repartition the schema by date and drop unnecessary indexes
Dark mode, which the Designer wants to prototype

user_segments.text: Evening users, who the Designer says would get less eye strain from dark mode
Users of the reporting dashboards, if the dataset grows to 5M rows

requests.text: Designer wants to prototype dark mode off the roadmap

decisions.text: Add the notification redesign to the backlog
Add the schema repartitioning to the backlog and schedule the actual planning later
Keep dark mode in the ideas backlog, not the roadmap
The Designer may prototype dark mode off the roadmap

open_questions.text: How many customers want dark mode? Not known yet
The Engineer Lead asked whether anyone checked Slack about the API outage yesterday; the Designer had not seen anything and the topic was not picked up again

action_items.text: Engineer Lead to send a calendar invite for the next sync, next week or maybe Wednesday

metrics_mentioned.text: 8 user tests; 6 of them missed the bell initially (the Designer says about 75%)
Only 12% of users have notifications enabled
On a 1M row dataset, a simple GROUP BY takes 7 seconds
A competing tool does the same in under 1 second
If the dataset grows to 5M rows, reporting dashboards will be unusable; not affecting users directly yet
Estimated fix: maybe 2 weeks of work
